observations: What I read: the full request JSON and source. I opened storyboards-unnumbered/page-04.png and both cast sheets with Read and looked at them. For the numbered order I read reading-flow/page-04.json as text.

Open point (middle row): I judge it acceptable, not a defect. In 04-2 Ravi faces screen-left and in 04-3 Ananya faces screen-right, which keeps the Ananya-left/Ravi-right axis set in 04-1 and 04-4. Ravi must speak before Ananya listens, so his close-up has to come first (left).

The cost is that the two singles face outward across the gutter, back to back. For the art: keep Ravi's gaze and turn clearly toward the left frame edge, and put the closed laptop or desk edge on Ananya's right-hand side in 04-3 so her eyeline reads as aimed past the frame at him.
All lines match the source page 4. There is no follow-up question about tiredness and no diagnosis, as the source requires.
Ravi's reaction to the reassurance is planned in 04-4 (nod, relaxed, hands on knees).
04-1: there is one balloon at top-left with its tail to Ananya on the left. Ravi on the right is silent, so the question leads straight to the middle-left balloon, which is his answer.
04-3: the narration box is a square-cornered caption, clearly not speech, above a silent Ananya. It reads as the listening pause before her reply in 04-4.
04-4: the long balloon at top-left points to Ananya on the left. Ravi on the right is silent; the planned nod is his reaction.

transitions.observation: Reception to the consultation room. The desk, window and plant in the wide 04-1 make the place change clear, and the same costumes and bag, now set down beside the chair, show it is the same visit. Checked on the page-03 storyboard and plan only.
Cut from the two-shot to Ravi's close-up from the doctor's side, facing screen-left toward her. His hand moves from his knee to rubbing his neck as he answers her question.
Reverse single of Ananya facing screen-right, hands folded, closed laptop at the desk edge. Screen direction is consistent with 04-1 even though the two panels face outward across the gutter.
Back to a two-shot with the same left/right placement. Her folded hands open into a reassuring gesture and Ravi relaxes, hands on his knees.

Place change back to reception after the consultation. The bag is back on Ravi's shoulder and the desk is familiar from page 3, but the camera reverses to Meera-left/Ravi-right. The wide desk-corner two-shot and the page break carry that reversal. Checked on the page-05 storyboard and plan only.

readingReview.comparison: The natural order matches the intended order and numbered JSON. The first reading's concerns are a missing place cue (covered by the 04-1 room art), the caption sitting between complaint and reply (an intended listening beat), the thin consultation (required by the source's no-advice rule) and Ravi's missing reaction (planned 04-4 nod). Facing the singles outward is an accepted cost of keeping the axis.
